original_test_intent: Inspect every scoped node, component and cable connection against the approved Mechanical-AVL design to verify correct mating and position, absence of mismatch or bent pins, and acceptable cable routing. The source does not require disconnecting or cycling an already connected part.
original_method: A qualified engineer follows an approved connection map, visually and physically examines each scoped endpoint and route, and records photographs and defects. The agent may prepare the coverage matrix and collect associated read-only state, but it must not add a plug cycle that the source did not request.
manual_activity: The engineer resolves the connection topology, inspects mating identity, orientation, pin and latch condition, seating, strain relief and cable route at every listed node/component/cable endpoint, and judges physical compliance from direct access.
required_inputs: Approved node/component/cable connection diagram and complete target list
Connector identities, orientations, retention features and mating criteria
Cable route, bend, clearance, strain and keep-out requirements
Power/ESD handling rules for inspection and any separately approved manipulation
Expected device or management state for supporting evidence
Qualified operator, per-connection photo checklist and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Inspection alone does not authorize disconnecting, reseating or plug-cycling a connection; obtain explicit project approval if manipulation is added.
Do not touch an energized or hazardous connection unless the exact procedure permits it; protect ESD-sensitive nodes and adjacent cabling.
Do not force, rotate or probe a connector, and stop on mismatch, bent pins, damaged latch, pinching, abrasion, excessive strain or unsafe proximity to heat or moving parts.
Preserve dmesg, syslog and SEL history and use timestamped deltas instead of clearing evidence.
Do not automatically reseat, reroute, reboot or power-cycle to investigate an observed defect.
agent_execution_scope: Build a traceable connection checklist from approved topology and routing drawings.
Collect permitted read-only pre-inspection device, host and BMC state without changing connections.
Index operator photographs to each endpoint and flag missing coverage or observable discrepancies for engineer review.
Collect approved post-inspection event deltas only if the plan includes a physical action.
engineer_actions: Approve the connection scope and whether observation-only or any physical manipulation is permitted.
Inspect every scoped endpoint and route and document physical condition.
Stop and control any mismatch, damage or unsafe route without unplanned corrective action.
Apply Mechanical-AVL criteria and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The manual-only marker fits the source, but its plug/unplug wording exceeds this row. Remote status can support inventory but cannot prove pin condition, mating, position or route.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No universal command applies across nodes, components and cables. Use only project-mapped read-only inventory or health collection when it supports a named connection; do not infer mechanical compliance from normal enumeration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 remain unchanged. The source defines neither a plug cycle nor loop count, command, correction action or retry.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map every source-to-destination connection to connector IDs and route checkpoints, attach photographs for mating, retention and routing, and correlate only relevant read-only device state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected node interconnect, component population and cable topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis, node, board, cable and drawing revisions plus any evidence-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable Mechanical-AVL, connection and cable-routing documentation; no generic connector or bend criteria are asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes all connections auditable and distinguishes inspection from optional manipulation without changing the acceptance criteria.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Complete coverage requires all scoped endpoints and routes. Software-visible endpoints alone do not cover passive, hidden or mechanical features.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Topology, connector map, routing rules, inspection scope and acceptance criteria.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Photographs may not reveal hidden pins or internal contact quality; normal device state does not prove physical conformance.

project_override_considerations: A project may narrow inspection to defined nodes, assemblies or cable paths and may separately approve a reseat. Record both the subset and any added manipulation; do not report uninspected connections or an unrequested plug cycle as master-case coverage.
expected_evidence: Connection inventory with source/destination, connector ID and approved orientation
Per-connection checklist and timestamped photographs of mating, pins/latches, position and routing
Route exceptions, inaccessible areas and any observed mismatch or damage
Mapped read-only device/BMC state and preserved event delta where applicable
Safety stops and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and both criteria consistently require inspection of connection, position, pins and routing. The absent topology is a project input, not an internal contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The inspection intent is clear. A specific project cannot execute until it supplies the target list and drawings, but the library review is not blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain NO/manual-only, remove the unsupported assumption that a plug cycle is part of this row, and require endpoint/route traceability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with connection drawings and conditional post-action evidence; explicitly separate observation-only source scope from a project-added manipulation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines complete physical coverage and prevents an automation or safety regression caused by unrequested reseating.

review_improvement: This review retains the source as a connection inspection rather than turning it into the neighboring plug-cycle pattern. It also requires an auditable node/component/cable topology so generic photos cannot stand in for complete coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Correct mating, position, pin condition and routing are physical properties, so the core cannot be completed remotely. Because the source only says check, adding disconnect/reconnect would increase risk and alter the method. Read-only state is useful supporting evidence but cannot replace direct inspection. Missing drawings affect execution readiness rather than creating a permanent BLOCKED classification.

no_automatic_retry: On mismatch, bent pin, damaged latch, unsafe routing, missing endpoint or new system error, preserve photographs and raw state and stop. Do not reseat, reroute, substitute a cable, reboot or power-cycle unless a new engineer-approved plan authorizes it.
